$comment: The PDFs themselves are NOT committed (see root .gitignore) — they are private
local test fixtures. This manifest is the committed contract: it pins each file
by sha256 so a corpus that drifts is detected instead of silently changing the
corpusDir is the path INSIDE the OMR container. docker-compose mounts
groundTruth is null until a human reads the printed score and fills it in
(task P1-T13). null means 'not yet verified', never 'verified as absent'.
Regression checking works without it; accuracy scoring does not.
coverageGaps: 7 of 10 fixtures are single-page, so the relieur merge stage (P3) and the
silent partial-failure path are barely exercised. Add at least one 8+ page
score before trusting the merge numbers.
All fixtures are born-digital engraving. No scanned/photographed input, which
is the harder real-world case. Add one scan before Phase 2 concludes.

fixtures.file: Frédéric Chopin - Prelude in E Minor.pdf
fixtures.title: Prelude in E Minor
fixtures.notes: Slow homophonic texture, dense LH chords. Baseline case for chord recognition.

fixtures.file: By CLAUDE DEBUSSY - CLAIR DE LUNE.pdf
fixtures.title: Clair de Lune
fixtures.notes: Cross-staff writing and triplets. Stresses hand assignment (P7).

fixtures.file: By YANN TIERSEN - Comptine d’un autre été_ L’après-midi.pdf
fixtures.title: Comptine d'un autre ete: L'apres-midi
fixtures.notes: Ostinato LH, repeated structure. Good repeat/volta case. Non-ASCII filename.

fixtures.file: Composed by Joe Hisaishi - Howl’s Moving Castle_(The Merry-Go-Round Of Life).pdf
fixtures.title: Howl's Moving Castle (The Merry-Go-Round of Life)
fixtures.notes: 3/4 waltz, wide LH leaps. Tests span and leap features.

fixtures.file: Joe Hisaishi_Arr. by Piano Seeds STUDIO - Howl's Moving Castle.pdf
fixtures.title: Howl's Moving Castle
fixtures.notes: 3 pages — exercises the relieur merge and page-seam continuity. Pairs with the fixture above for arrangement-vs-arrangement comparison.

fixtures.title: Interstellar Theme
fixtures.notes: 2 pages, arpeggiated ostinato, long sustains. Multi-page merge case.

fixtures.file: By HANS ZIMMER, _RYAN RUBIN and ALEX BIBSON - CORNFIELD CHASE.pdf
fixtures.title: Cornfield Chase
fixtures.notes: Filename contains a leading comma-underscore artefact; useful shell-quoting canary.

fixtures.file: Music by Justin Hurwitz - MIA & SEBASTIAN’S THEME.pdf
fixtures.title: Mia & Sebastian's Theme
fixtures.notes: Ampersand and curly apostrophe in the filename and title — metadata escaping canary.

fixtures.file: Patrick Watson - Je Te Laisserai Des Mots.pdf
fixtures.title: Je Te Laisserai Des Mots
fixtures.notes: 2 pages, largest file. Likely carries lyrics — exercises the lyric path.

groundTruthTemplate.$comment: Copy into a fixture's groundTruth and fill in by reading the printed PDF.
